Name: Dino Valley - Chickens to Dinos
Author: Kingofwasps
Description:
I saw [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27091]this mod[/url] that turns the dinosaurs into green chickens and I decided [b]No We Need More Dinosaurs Not Less[/b]

Side note - funny idea; use this mod and the above one to turn all chickens into dinosaurs and the dinosaur into a chicken - reverse uno card

This mod was 100% a joke but after 20 minutes I am invested so there will be more updates to it along the line

There are six assets total including a lighter blue variant that I named Totodile bc the color palette was similar
By default you will not see Totodile - I haven't made a mod like this before so I don't really know what I'm doing so I don't think it will work with Generic Mod Config - however I have played with mods like this so if you want to change any of them and don't know how I will put a small thing here explaining it.

[list=1]
[*]Go to where you have the mod installed and open the Content.json with a word editor (I use notepad++ but I think anything will work)
[*]Change the line "FromFile": "assets/Vanilla White.png" to "FromFile": "assets/Totodile.png" or whichever version you wish to change (Brown, Void, Golden, any of them) to the asset you want this can also be any of them

[*]Save and close and when you open the game it should be the version you want
[/list]
 Things this mod currently does
[list]
[*]Turns the White, Brown, Blue, Void, Golden chickens, and rabbits all into Dinosaurs
[*]The colors for them have all been picked from the chickens directly and matched up best I can
[*]Turns baby versions of the above into dinos as well no baby sprite for them because the default dino doesn't have a baby sprite
[/list]
This this mod currently does NOT
[list]
[*]Change the pricing
[*]Change ducks
[*]Change worth of the items

[/list]
Things I will (probably) be updating the mod to do along the line
[list]
[*][s]Turn the chicks into Dinosaurs as well (again will probably be a fast fix but I'm lazy rn)[/s]
[*]Adjust the colors into better ones and add more choices
[*]retexture the eggs and mayo into "dino" variants (this will not make them worth but but will make them look similar to the dino egg and mayo with have in game already)
[*]Make [s]rabbits and [/s]ducks into dinosaurs as well
[*]Get it working with Generic Mod Config (I don't know if it works with it or not right now bc I didn't think to test it)
[*](MAYBE) change Marine's shop icons to dinosaurs
[/list]
